notes.title: 《无尽塔防:活下去》将转为免费游戏公告
notes.content:
亲爱的玩家们，大家好！
我是New Folder。游戏上架的几个月以来，《无尽塔防：活下去》收到了很多鼓励，这给我提供了很大的信心，也很感谢给我提出的玩法批评建议，我真心接受并感谢这些能够给予我优化方向的玩家。
我是一个个人开发者，这是我用y3做的第一款steam游戏。没有游戏上架经验，其实我很迷茫，中间走了很多弯路。在网上搜了很多游戏开发教程，都在教我不要全听玩家的意见，实际上我是很希望玩家多给我提意见，让我知道哪些地方做得不好，这样我才能在做游戏的道路上继续成长。犹豫再三，我决定《无尽塔防：活下去》在1月21日将会免费上架，希望能够把我做的第一款steam游戏开放分享给更多玩家，不断进步。
同时对于前期支持我的玩家们，我也正在准备一些补偿福利，一周之后会确定好并通知给大家，也欢迎进群（Q群:907832371）找群主提议，共同商讨福利内容。PS：我正在开发的下一款游戏也会免费上架，以回报大家。
祝大家玩得开心！希望热爱游戏的人能一直坚持下去！

notes.title: December 10th Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Fix the tower spirit not attacking.
2. Fix the abnormal appearance of monsters in F1.
3. Fix the abnormal display of buffs.
4. Fix certain weapons not dealing damage.

notes.title: Update Notes for December 7
notes.content:
1. Survival Mode Arrives
* Unlocked after clearing N6, challenge the limits of survival amidst monster assaults.
* Added 10 elite characters with special skills, appearing at intervals. Defeat them to choose one of three options for growth in [Resources], [Items & Orange Weapons], or [Attributes]. Elite skills can be viewed in their buff section.
* New achievements for various modes have been added. Players can check them under - Career - Achievements - Game Achievements - General. Surviving 14 minutes earns the "Last Survivor" badge, which has impressive skills.

2. Skill Adjustments
* Fire Focus skill cooldown reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds.

3. System Optimization
* Soul Stone Road unlock time reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds.

4. New Levels in the Encyclopedia
* New levels in the weapon encyclopedia have been opened. Players can use resources obtained in Survival Mode for upgrades.

5. Bug Fixes
* Fixed an issue where daily first clears would not drop rewards in certain situations.

notes.title: November 28 Update Notes

notes.title: November 22 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Bug Fixes

notes.title: November 21 Update Notes
notes.content: The bug that prevented tower spirits from possessing has been fixed. We are also urgently optimizing the transition back to the main menu after a match. Thank you for your support, players!

notes.title: Endless Tower Defense officially launches on November 21st!
notes.content:
This is a innovative roguelike TD game made with the 『Y3 Editor』. No need for path planning or tower combos—just one tower!  With almost 100 weapons, you’ll be mowing down foes and dominating the battlefield. Enjoy the rush and let off some steam!

As a hardcore tower defense enthusiast, I set out to create a non-traditional roguelike tower defense game. Endless Tower Defense: Survive is a game I developed over two months using the 『Y3 Editor』. If you're interested in discussing, providing feedback, or just having a laugh, feel free to join our QQ group: 907832371.

Intense Mowing Action, Ultimate Stress Relief
No need for rapid operations – just click to enjoy the idle roguelike fun. Face endless waves of monsters, equip weapons, upgrade the tower soul to harvest the horde, and gather resources to upgrade your tower and soul. Dual-wield your tower and soul to defeat bosses and experience the ultimate thrill of endless mowing.

Variety and Depth, Never Gets Boring
With nearly a hundred unique weapons and upgrade effects, enjoy the thrill of mowing down enemies while stacking top-tier roguelike experiences, ensuring each battle delivers double the excitement. Balance your weapon combinations and upgrade effects to optimize offense and defense, allowing for infinite mowing and stress relief.

Tower and Soul Synergy, United We Stand
Explore the abyss to gather soul stones and enhance your tower soul for combat assistance. Whether dual-wielding with separate attack paths or merging them into the ultimate defense tower, you'll experience the ultimate mowing thrill.

Adapt and Conquer, Master the Elements
Against different enemies, remember the counter rules: Metal crushes medium armor; Piercing counters light armor; Magic defeats heavy armor; Siege breaks reinforced armor; Chaos weapons treat all equally, ignoring armor! Use the right weapon to mow down enemies faster and more efficiently!
